questions.prompt: What mistake does the boy describe at the Lincoln Memorial?
questions.explanation: 男孩说原应为 FUTURE，却刻成 EUTURE，差在第一个字母。题目只核对对话中的说法，不将娱乐对话的历史细节当作独立事实核验；也不是桥梁或火车命名。
answers: A word was carved with the wrong first letter.
options: A bridge was built on the wrong side.
A train was given the wrong name.
A word was carved with the wrong first letter.

questions.prompt: What change in the tour vehicle’s route especially excites Anna?
questions.evidence: A minute ago, we were riding along the river, and now we’re riding in the river!
questions.explanation: along the river 是沿河，in the river 是进入河里，Anna 兴奋的是同一辆车能从陆路驶入水中。飞机是从她们头顶飞过，不是旅游车飞起来。
answers: It moves from beside the river into the water.
options: It stops permanently at the station.
It moves from beside the river into the water.

questions.prompt: Which building do they pass on their right? Write ONE WORD.
questions.evidence: we’re passing by the Pentagon on our right!
questions.explanation: on our right 表示在她们右边，明确对应 Pentagon。Lincoln Memorial 先前在左边，不能只因两个地标都出现就忽略方位。题目要求一个词，不加 the。

questions.prompt: Why does the boy say the tunnels near the Capitol were built?
questions.evidence: The lawmakers did not want to walk around outside in bad weather.
questions.explanation: 男孩给出的理由是议员不想在坏天气中走室外。Anna 猜测秘密用途，随即被 No 更正，因此不能把她的猜测当成男孩的解释。
answers: To avoid walking outside in bad weather.
options: To hide secret treasure from tourists.
To connect the Capitol directly to the airport.
To avoid walking outside in bad weather.

questions.prompt: Where does the boy say there used to be a funeral home?
questions.evidence: Many years ago, inside Union Station, there was a funeral home!
questions.explanation: inside Union Station 是旧殡仪馆的位置。under the Capitol 属于前面隧道话题；Pentagon 是途经地标，都不能替代这里的位置。此题核对原文表述。

questions.prompt: Why is Anna surprised by the captain’s reply about the young guide?
questions.evidence: I’ve never seen that boy in my life!
questions.explanation: Anna 以为男孩是船长的儿子，船长却说一辈子没见过这个孩子，构成结尾的惊讶。不能把 Anna 的 Your son 当成已经确认的亲属关系。
answers: He says he has never seen the boy before.
options: He says he has never seen the boy before.
He says the boy is too young to speak.
He says the tour has not started yet.
